root_cause_analysis.primary_root_cause: Production configuration crash on Render startup before Uvicorn binds port
mechanism: Render service environment variables lacked AUTH_SESSION_SECRET because it is gitignored in .env and was not generated or set in Render manual service dashboard.
backend/app/core/config.py ran settings.validate_production_security() at module import time which raised RuntimeError on missing/default secret.
backend/start.py executed alembic upgrade head as a subprocess. Alembic imported config.py, failed with exit code 1, and start.py invoked sys.exit(res.returncode).
The container terminated before binding , resulting in Render edge TLS router returning 100% gateway timeouts (HTTP 504 / connection hang).
root_cause_analysis.secondary_root_cause: Frontend GitHub Pages API base URL omission
root_cause_analysis.secondary_mechanism: frontend/src/api/config.ts returned empty string for getApiBaseUrl() on algoryxz.github.io when VITE_API_URL was unset, attempting relative fetches against GitHub Pages origin instead of https://otravelz-backend.onrender.com.

principles_applied: Reuse existing implementation without speculative abstractions
Preserve fail-closed semantics for test suite while gracefully recovering runtime singleton in production
Make run_migrations non-aborting so health probes and web services can start even if DB is already at head
verifications: Production environment simulation initializes without error
